narrative.details:
Okay, here you go.

I'm going to be over here... behind cover.

Feel free to join me.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, perfect. Stand back while I prepare to make more history!

<Lotwil continues to work feverishly.>
narrative.requestItemsText:
<Without looking up from the shackles, Lotwil holds out a hand and waggles his fingers impatiently.>

The cog, adventurer, the cog!
